_doc: Bloat firewall. Ceilings are NON-INCREASING and ratchet DOWN as code shrinks, never up without operator approval. Two operator-approved exceptions on record: the 2026-08-03 one-time test-pool correction at the Dream V1 landing (maxima 11600/85000), and the 2026-08-14 Breakthrough Pass raise (+300 production for the deterministic editor safety checks and the multi-page differentiation producer; operator authorized ratcheting mechanical budgets blocking the MVP, recorded here and in the campaign report). Enforced by scripts/check-foundation-budget.mjs (npm run guard:foundation). Foundation is frozen; see AGENTS.md for the growth policy and the 8-field feature rule. Third and fourth operator-authorized exceptions, 2026-08-16 final outcome run: ceilings set to the exact landed counts after the operator rejected the prior completion and ordered the continuation (canonical demand units + loader + history aggregate consumer, demand-recovery producer, answer-journey reasoning, self-starting backfill, generalized rendered reads, banked-copy earning re-read, and their tests); every ceiling remains exact-count and non-increasing from here. 2026-08-18 tenth-contract reconciliation, operator-approved interactively BEFORE shipping: the unapproved fifth raise was reversed (production ratcheted DOWN to 74,374 after deleting four dead modules; combined down to 87,097; exports back to 1,343 exact), and the operator approved tests at the exact landed count 12,723 because every line over the old ceiling is the contract's own counterexample suite (proposition search, typed failures, coverage chunks, dedupe, publisher diversity, global attempt bound, one canonical day, migration immutability, publish-not-called). Fifth authorized adjustment, 2026-08-19 AEO reconstruction (program clause: smallest exact ceiling adjustment after superseded deletion, recorded precisely): production DOWN 74374 to 73939 and exports DOWN 1343 to 1339 after deleting the Profound-era parallel AI record (canonical-store, cold-store, prompt-answer-observations dual write, citation-observations, the deep-dive ai_absence door and aiDemand); tests UP 12723 to 12835 for the AEO counterexample suite (fan-out recurrence, AI-seeded demand, staged cases, recurrence ranking, typed shipment scope, exact-scope measurement); combined DOWN 87097 to 86774. Net ceiling change is MINUS 323 lines. Sixth authorized adjustment, 2026-08-21, operator approval recorded verbatim after Codex accepted Phase 2 of the correction program: ceilings set to the exact landed counts of the deployed hardening pass (production 75,038; tests 13,815; combined 88,853; exports 1,374). The added code protects money (the pause is a spending boundary with never-cached permission), tenant security (service-role-only hardened verdict writer), concurrency (owner-token rebuild lease), durable decisions (ai_case_dispositions with superseded semantics) and the counterexample tests that caught live defects. This is a ratchet to exact counts, not permission for growth: Phases 3 to 10 must replace or delete enough to stay inside these numbers, and every ceiling ratchets DOWN when replacement work deletes code. Seventh authorized adjustment, 2026-08-21, operator approval recorded verbatim after Codex accepted Closures A, B and C1 and C2's measurement methodology: ceilings set to the exact landed counts of the measurement replacement (production 75,605; tests 14,276; combined 89,881; exports 1,387), which remains 10,119 lines below the permanent 100,000 MVP cap. What the overage buys: the three-part verdict rule that replaced FLAT_BAND (practical threshold, interval excluding zero, adequate denominators), same-instrument controls off the account's own unaffected questions with their drift subtracted, per-engine verdicts with an honest split, terminal Not-measurable, the authorship label, and the counterexample suite the correction program itself specified. Exact-count ratchet, not permission to grow. 2026-08-26 terminal-closure adjustment (operator pre-authorized in the terminal contract): after deleting the 1,600-line proof-timeline subsystem and the dead cost/continuation plumbing, production max RATCHETED DOWN 75605->74500 and exports 1387->1370 (landed: 73,871 prod, 1,362 exports); tests 14276->14500 for the composed acceptance contracts; combined 89881->89100; per-file ceilings set to the landed sizes of the five closure files plus research-steps.ts (546) and bundle-detail.tsx (507) grandfathered at their long-standing sizes. Non-increasing from here. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +0, tests +128, combined +178; per-file src/domains/decision/drafted-copy.ts 718 to 739. Reason: Round 1 of the research-to-useful-change loop replaces two contracts and deletes the paths they superseded in the same commits. Deleted in decision (D1): the evaluator's universal improvesPage clause and usefulAndNatural form rules (EVALUATOR_SYSTEM itself), the TASK table and its evidence-id selector, synthesisTooThin, GAIN.TOO_THIN, the TITLE_SHAPE_CLAUSE bans and the blanket call-to-action refusal. Deleted in runtime (R1): firstRound and the first-round reservation with its 'starting this needs N charged calls' decline, PhaseOutcome.pause and its driveRun handler, ResearchRunError.failures, and the three duplicated replenishReady call expressions. The replacements are one typed editorial standard per treatment read by every door (with its proof file, tests/decision/editorial-standard.test.ts, 124 lines on two synthetic tenants) and one per-drive working context with money spent rather than committed. drafted-copy.ts grows to 739 because the six standards and their shared mechanical requirements now live in one place instead of two contradictory messages; production stays at its ceiling exactly. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +0, tests +71, combined +71; per-file none. Reason: Round 2 of the research-to-useful-change loop, tests raised by exactly the landed proofs (D2 +54 on two synthetic tenants for the five passage verdicts, the group floor, the count rule, the repositioning exemption, the router and the draft provenance class; R2 +11 for the shared scoring context, the replay door and the waited demotion; orchestrator +6 pinning that a relational word the searcher used must be matched by the text that claims to answer). Production is unchanged at its ceiling. Deleted in decision (D2): the token-absence verdict (asked, label and the sixteen-word INFLECTION list in diagnosis.ts), PageDemand.stored and storedWords in drafted-copy.ts, the unconditional count-claim branch in drafts/draft-quality.ts, the twenty-four first-person refusal sentences. Deleted in the runtime lane (R2): whyAbove's unreachable readiness and overlap cases and the duplicated page-key spellings and measuring Set in rank-proposals.ts, the unread state.blocker write in on-visit-refresh.ts, the alphabetical sort in technical-findings.ts. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +43, tests +85, combined +128; per-file none. Reason: Round two and a half of the research-to-useful-change loop: production +43 (D2b +20: the tokenizer's closed-class stop list, the shape-word and largest-unanswered-group rules, page understanding's three stored fields with their prompt lines and store round trip, the readings-taken terminal; R2b +23: the acquisition receipt on the run row with its typed outcome, the one buy door, the pass-stamped outcomes, the two-arm strategic factor), tests +85 (D2b +13 on two synthetic tenants: the seed test and the readings terminal; R2b +72: one purchase per reading, pending work across drives, receipts as the pass's own, the account-goal dimension, the abandoned-run reclaim), combined +128. Deleted in the same commits. D2b: the need, relates and answers locals of demandGap folded into one readerOf closure, the standalone one-passage-answers line the group selection subsumes, the two-line Row, decode and save field blocks in page-understanding.ts and the three-line schema block in schemas.ts folded onto their lines, and the inert accountGoal row field and its zod member. R2b: fifteen first-person templates in technical-findings.ts replaced in place, the three identical page-path derivations in research-steps.ts replaced by one pathOf, four log lines superseded by the durable per-purchase receipt, the unconditional source pass for a proposition the seed had already answered, the boughtNeeds map and its two writes in on-visit-refresh.ts, two log lines and two duplicated catch spellings in the purchase loops replaced by the one buy door, the unconditional carry of replenish.outcomes in carriedDayState, and the single-arm strategic discount in rank-proposals.ts. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +-1, tests +0, combined +-1; per-file none. Reason: Ratchet after the round two and a half reviewer's blocking fix: the declared-but-unwritten unlocks field on the evidence requirement is deleted (it was stripped by the persistence schema on the first save), so production and combined come down by the one line it occupied. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +40, tests +227, combined +267; per-file exports 1370 to 1371. Reason: Round three of the research-to-useful-change loop: production +40 (D2c +10: the proportional evidence bar's two rules with their measurements, the intent comparison, the unlocks field kept whole; D3 +30: the applied piece's own label, the operator's applied wording beside the prepared one, the typed retryable answer, the per-card bulk result, the settled no-expectation verification), tests +227 (D2c +103, D3 +124, every one a behavioural proof on two synthetic tenants), combined +267, exports 1,370 to 1,371 for exactly one symbol, RELATIONAL, moved into the evidence layer so the decision-side copy could be deleted. Deleted in the same commits. D2c: the private RELATES regex and its declaration in diagnosis.ts, the single-grade conjunct and the single-authority arm in fact-checks.ts replaced in place, the em dash in the evidence string, two orphaned doc comments in research-run.ts. D3: the retired live-check suppression flag and the bulk operator note, the operator_confirmed verification status no record carries and its due-rule clause, the duplicated no-copy branch in the classifier, the first-error-only bulk sentence, the ambiguous note field and its state. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +43, tests +169, combined +212; per-file none. Reason: Round four of the research-to-useful-change loop: production +43 (R3 alone; D2d's lane is net zero, every added line paid for by folding): raw movement beside the adjusted comparison with the clause that says which moved, the learning row carrying the measurement state and controls receipt the funding door reads, Today answering every settled reading, the stale-connector sentence beside source freshness, the sweep loading the whole family from the inventory with the pass receipt saying how many loaded, the demotion path composing through the one gate-opener composer, the runtime asking the corrections authorization whether a reading is usable; tests +169 (D2d +46: the family's determinism and the timurid fix with mutation proofs, the opportunity name, the zero rule, the record repair; R3 +123: proof 15 on two synthetic tenants, Today's answers, the usable-reading rule both directions, the family read), combined +212, exports unchanged at 1,371. Deleted in the same commits. D2d: the sixty-word GENERIC set of one account's nouns in drafted-copy.ts, the union-of-siblings and praise-as-family readings of the first attempt, the writer's brief standing as the opportunity line, the unconditional superlative clause. R3: unadjustedLine's insufficient-comparison guard, the single shaping rule and the fixed teaches sentence in results-brain.ts, the learning row built without measurementState and controlsReceipt, the piece label carried into learning, lastWinLine's win-only branch and its raw address, the held-rows window in produce-proposals.ts, the demotion path's raw why2 and owned writes, the confirmed-grade mirror in research-steps.ts, twenty-two first-person product sentences and nine long-dash characters at net zero. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +2, tests +15, combined +17; per-file none. Reason: The round-four reviewer's blocking fix, landed with the round: the page-body loader re-asks a capped read for the pages it left unanswered and labels a page still unanswered after a cut that answered nothing as unknown rather than absent (two pages with dozens of stored versions had taken a chunk's whole row budget, three pages with three captures each came back with no row, and the sibling rule fell silent on a missing self); the template rule holds a page whose own body was not read this pass exactly as it holds unread siblings; the sweep keeps a read-incomplete hold apart from a real refusal, so it blocks this pass and is never composed into a fault, never buys a corrective draft and never demotes a Ready row. Production +2 (the seven-line single-shot query folded into a bounded re-ask loop; the partition folded onto the line it belongs to), tests +15 (three pins: the re-ask on a capped fake, the unread self, the partition through the real sweep on two synthetic tenants).

tests._note: 14650 since 2026-08-29 by explicit operator authorization, for the source-to-claim support cutover, WHICH IS LANDED: artifact v2 minted inside the fact judgement, the one authorization gate, the deterministic fallback, the backfill, and the live-shape fixtures. The suite landed at exactly 14650, so the authorized ceiling IS the ratchet: not a line of the grant is unspent headroom, and the next behaviour pays for itself by consolidation or deletion, exactly as before the grant.

domains._note: The five kernels: account, evidence, decision, measurement, runtime. No new top-level domain without operator approval.

files._note: NEW production file may not exceed newFileMax. Grandfathered files below carry a non-increasing ceiling = current size; shrink them, never grow. Clearing a file (trim under newFileMax) is encouraged.

imports._note: src/app + src/components consume the 5 kernels through their public facade (index.ts) only. Deep VALUE imports of kernel internals are forbidden; import type deep-imports are allowed (erased at compile).
imports._directionNote: Dependency direction: Account -> Evidence -> Decision -> Measurement; Runtime orchestrates. Forbidden: Evidence importing Decision/Measurement; Measurement importing Decision. Known pre-existing leaks are grandfathered below (non-increasing) and tracked for severance; no NEW leak may be added.

exports._note: Exported type/interface/class/enum/const/function symbols in src (non-test). Non-increasing; keep internal helpers/types internal. Ratchet DOWN.

markdown._note: Documentation budget. Git history is the archive. No docs/archive/. No new AUDIT/REPORT/WIP/HISTORY/ROADMAP/dated-plan docs without operator approval.

deps._note: Runtime dependencies. Adding one requires explicit operator approval.
